rules.title: Reliable
rules.description: An effect type. If a reliable power misses every target, the power is not expended.

limitations: Shared authoring definition; runtime interpretation and combat effects are not implemented by this migration.

rules.title: Invigorating
rules.description: The creature gains temporary hit points equal to their *Constitution* when it hits with a power that has the invigorating keyword. No invigorating power grants temporary hit points more than once during a turn, even if the user hits more than once with that power.

limitations: Shared authoring definition; runtime interpretation and combat effects are not implemented by this migration.
